about_the_game:
This game is ground breaking-ly fun! The most popular game at our local gamescom is now on Steam! This Game is Ground breaking is a couch-co-op game made to invoke the absolute chaos of playing split screen arcade games as a kid. This game will make you want to smash your friends head through the TV have unforgettable moments with your friends.

5-10 minutes of pure fun,




Remote Play Supported!

If you and your "Friend" wants to play together, you can do so via Remote Play.
Follow the instructions below on how to set it up.
Note: This is only required if you are playing with a friend on a remote PC, if you both are in the same PC skip this
Setup
 1. Open the Game
 2. The Host will need to have one additional Input Device (Controller) connected apart from the keyboard and mouse.

3. Shift+Tab, Right Click on Friend, Invite Remote Play.
4. Once they have Joined, Shift + Tab again, find the remote play Icon on the bottom, and you should see your friends name on the Remote play list.
5. Click on the Keyboard and Mouse Icon next to the Friends name (Give access).

6. Success! They should now be able to use their own Keyboard &Mouse or a Controller to play with you!.

How to Play

The objective is simple, outlast your friend in the arena.

If you step on a tile, the tile will fall shortly after. So be careful where you tread,

If you want to speed up the winning process, shoot explosives at the other friend which will break all the tiles instantly upon impact.


This game features ground breaking mechanics and new features such as.

- No micro-transactions: If we bother to make a skin, just take it.
- No battle-passes that unlock useless items on level up.
- No annoying ads asking you to review and rate our game. (We already know its awesome, we don't need you to tell us that.)



- Actually having a good time with your friends. (I know it's a bit out there but we think it just might work.)

Play with either 2 Controllers, or Single Controller and a Keyboard & Mouse.
